method: Each quotation was matched in a fresh retrieval of its text after Unicode compatibility normalisation (NFKC) and normalising whitespace, case, quotation marks and dashes, removing HTML tags and entities, and joining PDF line-break hyphens. The amendment itself (ADAMS ML26135A004, linked from the facility page) answered HTTP 403 from www.nrc.gov and pbadupws.nrc.gov, and the ADAMS search service refused the connection, so it was not read.

notice.facilityNote: The facility page embeds per-request tokens, so its SHA-256 differs between retrievals of the same text.
